answer: Reputation-weighted resource quotas. Each identity submits periodic liveness samples that a hidden validator set cross-checks; honest agents accrue an echo score raising their CPU and bandwidth limits. Cloning resets that score to zero, so each fake identity runs at minimum quota and must sustain its own liveness sampling cost. Willow-tier agents earn fivefold throughput, sable-tier tenfold, making N clones cost N times the sampling and storage overhead while yielding no parallel capacity gain.
